description: This file defines the interface for the ssp_messagebus in the RDK platform, including function declarations for message bus engagement, initialization, finalization, resource cleanup, and bus checking.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus component with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus status.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.
